basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, and by night, I dive deep into the mesmerizing world of virtual reality. I have a passion for indie games and quirky online communities. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new tech. My typical online hours are late evenings, often stretching well past midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Digital Media from the University of Texas and have self-taught myself through online courses and forums. My main interests revolve around virtual reality and digital art, and I enjoy staying updated with the latest in tech and gaming.
